messages:
maya: FYI PR tightened RBAC for scan-uploader and now SAST evidence upload fails in CI. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/scan-uploader/pull/99

drew: Hit a 403 on PutObject from prow, reproduced locally with prow auth.

ops-bot: [ci] job=upload-evidence status=failed run=2026-03-20T14:12:03Z

lia: KMS logs show: AccessDenied for kms:Decrypt key/aa11-bb22 principal: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/scan-uploader-session

maya: The PR removed the ephemeral grant path that flightdeck used. We rely on temporary decrypt grants for evidence keys.

sre-oncall: I can approve a short-lived grant via flightdeck (1h). Prefer scoped condition on principal tag.

drew: Proposed minimal policy: Allow kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11-bb22 Condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalTag/role=scan-uploader

maya: Also need audithook header added (x-audit-request-id) so we can correlate S3/KMS logs to a CI run. Without it chain-of-custody is weak.

lia: Agreed. Update pre-merge checklist: require (1) KMS review, (2) audithook header there, (3) owner signoff when changes touch evidence stores.

maya: I'll open a fix PR that: re-adds tag propagation to helm chart, adds scoped ephemeral grant in flightdeck, and inserts x-audit-request-id in uploader. Assigning @drew and @lia.

security-bot: [ticket] SEC-4001 created: evidence upload failed; artifacts: s3://evidence/ci/2026-03-20/99/*

sre-oncall: If this becomes an incident capture artifact hash, signer metadata, and audit-request id for full provenance.

maya: Will attach kube diff and sample PutObject trace to SEC-4001. Will update when flightdeck grant issued.
